mapper.sql: select n.notify_id, n.alert_id, n.receiver_id, n.status, n.is_read, n.read_time, n.confirm_time, n.del_flag, n.create_by, n.create_time, n.update_by, n.update_time, n.remark, su.nick_name as receiver_name, a.title as alert_title, a.alert_type, a.alert_level from notification n left join sys_user su on n.receiver_id = su.user_id left join alert a on n.alert_id = a.alert_id
mapper.select: select count(*) from notification where receiver_id = #{receiverId} and status = 'UNREAD' and del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update notification set status = 'READ', is_read = 1, read_time = sysdate, update_by = #{operName}, update_time = sysdate where notify_id = #{notifyId} and receiver_id = #{receiverId} and del_flag = '0'

update notification set status = 'CONFIRMED', is_read = 1, confirm_time = sysdate, update_by = #{operName}, update_time = sysdate where notify_id = #{notifyId} and receiver_id = #{receiverId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select distinct su.user_id from sys_user su left join sys_user_role ur on su.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.role_id where su.del_flag = '0' and su.status = '0' and ( su.user_id = 1 or (r.role_key = 'science_admin' and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0') )
